The artifact is fully loaded (kernel source, problem text, meta). I have enough context to record the description model for this FP16→FP32 erf case without further reads.

Key observations: the contract demands absolute error ≤ 1e-6 against exact erf for **every finite FP16 value** (domain is exhaustively enumerable, ~65536 values), while the kernel implements the A&S 7.1.26 five-coefficient rational approximation with coefficients **truncated to 5–6 significant digits** (1.06141, -1.45315, 1.42141, -0.28450, 0.25483) instead of the full-precision constants — the coefficient truncation errors (up to ~4.6e-6 each) cancel at x=0 but not generally, so mid-range |x| is the prime risk surface.

NaN/Inf excluded; contiguous strided CUDA tensor, ordinary mode, no autograd.", "Hard correctness bar: abs(actual[i]-erf(x[i])) <= 1e-6 for every element, relative tolerance zero, signed zeros numerically equivalent; single verdict over the whole domain, not per-input.", "erf target is real-arithmetic erf of the exact stored FP16 value; any approximation meeting the fixed absolute tolerance is acceptable; reference() = FP64 erf rounded to FP32 (accepts CPU).", "Frozen environment: NVIDIA T4, PyTorch 2.8.0, Triton 3.4.0."], "kernel_model": ["Triton kernel _erf_kernel: grid-strided blocks of 256, mask-guarded loads, upcast FP16->FP32, computes A&S 7.1.26 rational approximation erf(x) = 1 - t*(a1 + t*(a2 + t*(a3 + t*(a4 + t*a5)))) * exp(-x^2) with t = 1/(1+0.3275911|x|).", "Coefficients used are truncated to 5-6 significant digits: 1.06141, -1.45315, 1.42141, -0.28450, 0.25483 (full A&S constants are 1.061405429, -1.453152027, 1.421413741, -0.284496736, 0.254829592); A&S formula's own intrinsic max abs error is ~1.5e-7.", "Numerics detail: uses tl.div_rn (round-to-nearest divide), tl.exp for the Gaussian envelope, magnitude*magnitude in FP32 (65504^2 ~ 4.29e9 stays in FP32 range), sign restored via tl.where(x<0, -value, value) so x=-0.0 maps to +0.0 (zeros equivalent per contract).", "run(): validates inputs, allocates fresh FP32 output, launches with num_warps=4, enable_fp_fusion=False, BLOCK=256;
